data.assumption: “UK last week” means showroom country code GB/UK and the previous Monday-to-Sunday business-date week, 2026-08-31 through 2026-09-06.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
WHERE pa.is_test = FALSE
  AND o.is_test = FALSE
  AND LOWER(pa.method) = 'card'
  AND LOWER(pa.status) = 'failed'
  AND s.country_code IN ('GB', 'UK')
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-31'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-09-07'
